name: Hypermobility Spectrum Disorder
definition: Symptomatic generalized or regional joint hypermobility associated with pain, instability and functional symptoms when criteria for another heritable connective-tissue disorder are not met.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; targeted testing is used only when another connective-tissue disorder is suspected.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Avoid repeated immobilization and unnecessary invasive procedures; assess for true instability and comorbidities.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhi-asthirata phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Symptomatic generalized or regional joint hypermobility associated with pain, instability and functional symptoms when criteria for another heritable connective-tissue disorder are not met.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
